rules.name: The Expiry Week Call Wall Defense (The 96-100% Institutional Pin Trap)
rules.thesis: Physical delivery obligations prevent institutional call writers from allowing stock closes above Call Wall in expiry week. Dealers sell heavy cash equities to pin the stock below the wall.
rules.setupTrigger: Stock trades within 0.4% of its Call Wall during Period E, F, or G (11:15 AM - 12:45 PM) in Long Gamma regime.
rules.execution: BUY ATM Put (PE) or SELL OTM Call above the Call Wall. Strike = Call Wall strike.
rules.stopLoss: Spot close 0.5% above Call Wall (or Dynamic Option SL = Entry - (Risk * 0.5)).
rules.target: Reversion to Zero Gamma Flip / ATM strike (Average +1.5x to +2.0x Strike Step extension).
rules.protectiveFilter: NEVER fade Call Wall if volume is > 2.0x 20-bar average (indicates true institutional gamma squeeze).

rules.name: The Short Gamma Cascade Breakdown (100% With Index Confluence)
rules.instrumentScope: Banking & High-Beta Stocks (HDFCBANK, ICICIBANK, SBIN, RELIANCE)
rules.thesis: Once a stock crosses below its Zero Gamma Flip into Short Gamma, option dealers transition from dampening volatility to accelerating it—dealers MUST short underlying shares as price drops to stay delta-neutral.
rules.setupTrigger: Stock closes a 30m candle below the Zero Gamma Flip level AND NIFTY/BANKNIFTY is trading below its morning Open.
rules.execution: BUY ATM Put Option (PE) or Sell Near-Month Stock Futures.
rules.stopLoss: Spot cross back above Zero Gamma Flip level.
rules.target: Primary Put Wall boundary (Target 1) or Put Wall - 1 Strike Step (Target 2).
rules.protectiveFilter: 100% historical accuracy when confirmed with Bearish PCR Drift (< -0.03) in the broader index.

rules.name: The Put Wall Absorption Bounce (Institutional Bedrock Floor)
rules.thesis: Put Walls represent maximum dealer positive gamma from written puts. As price tests the Put Wall, dealer put delta approaches -0.50, forcing dealers to aggressively buy stock equities to hedge short delta.
rules.setupTrigger: Stock low pierces Put Wall by <= 0.3%, absorbs selling volume, and candle closes back above Put Wall.
rules.execution: BUY ATM Call Option (CE) at candle close.
rules.stopLoss: Low of the sweep candle (just below Put Wall).
rules.target: Mean Zero Gamma Flip Level or Fair Value EMA (Average +1.2x to +1.8x Strike Step).
rules.protectiveFilter: Invalidate if stock prints negative CVD delta sweep without any absorption wick.

rules.name: The Forced Gamma Squeeze Drive (Dealers Trapped Naked Short Calls)
rules.instrumentScope: High Momentum / Breakout Stocks (RELIANCE, BAJFINANCE, TATASTEEL)
rules.thesis: When institutional demand blasts through the Call Wall on heavy volume, dealers who sold naked OTM calls suffer accelerating delta (gamma risk). They are forced to aggressively buy stock shares at any ask price to hedge.
rules.setupTrigger: Stock closes strictly ABOVE Call Wall on volume >= 1.3x baseline AND Index is in Bullish Long Gamma.
rules.execution: BUY ATM Call Option (CE) or Long Futures in Period G or Period H.
rules.stopLoss: Retracement back below Call Wall (Spot SL = Call Wall - 0.2%).
rules.target: +2.0 to +3.0 Strike Steps above Call Wall (Gamma Vacuum Zone).
rules.protectiveFilter: Only valid if breakout occurs before 2:15 PM (Periods C to H). Late-day breakouts after 2:45 PM require 1.5x volume.

rules.name: The Delta-Neutral Expiry Pinning Strangle / Iron Condor Rule
rules.instrumentScope: Low-Beta F&O Giants (ITC, TCS, INFY, HINDUNILVR, NTPC)
rules.thesis: On the final Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday of monthly expiry, massive GEX clustering between Call Wall and Put Wall pins the stock tightly. Max pain and dealer gamma force price into a microscopic corridor.
rules.setupTrigger: Stock opens final 3 days inside the Call Wall - Put Wall corridor with Net GEX > +150 Cr in Long Gamma.
rules.execution: SELL OTM Strangle (Sell Call above Call Wall + Sell Put below Put Wall) or Iron Condor.
rules.stopLoss: Spot breakout beyond Call Wall + 1 Step or Put Wall - 1 Step.
rules.target: 100% Theta decay / zero option value at 3:30 PM Thursday Expiry.
rules.protectiveFilter: Exit immediately if broader market enters High-VIX regime (India VIX > 18.0).
